// diagnostic E0946

Jet.DispatchHoleCount

An `if` table header holds one `<>` hole, and this one has 2

What

An `if` table header holds one `<>` hole, and this one has 2

Why

Each arm's candidate takes the place of the one `<>`, so a second `<>` would stand for nothing.

Fix

Keep one `<>` and write the other value out in the header.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.DispatchHoleCount: Tests/UI/e0946_dispatch_hole_twice.stderr.
